title: Yes building out word walls and showing kids patterns are a great way to learn. Never understood a vocabulary, maybe a section on a measure of content
summary: Yes building out word walls and showing kids patterns are a great way to learn. Never understood a vocabulary, maybe a section on a measure of content knowledge but not testing vocabulary for vocabulary's sake. Immerse kids in words and measure how they use vocabulary not how they recite it.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Yes building out word walls and showing kids patterns are a great way to learn. Never understood a vocabulary, maybe a section on a measure of content knowledge but not testing vocabulary for vocabulary's sake.

Immerse kids in words and measure how they use vocabulary not how they recite it.
